references.text: The second census in the plains of Moab shows a similar total number of Israelites, confirming God's faithfulness in preserving the people through their wilderness journey.
The age limit of twenty years and older for those to be counted was first established in connection with the ransom money for the tabernacle.
Refers to the earlier census of men from twenty years and older, which provided the basis for the number in this census.
Repeats the criteria for the census: all who are able to go out to war, from twenty years and older.
The following verse gives the exact total of 603,550 men who were counted.
Summarizes again the total number of Israelites mustered according to their fathers' houses.
God's judgment on those counted from twenty years and older: that they should die in the wilderness because of their grumbling.
